verdict.reason: Pages say Overview is in Developer Platform and Post editor is in Content Studio, with a mode switch beneath the Blotato name.

steps.text: Blotato has 2 navigation modes, and Overview is in Developer Platform, which is for monitoring.
Post editor is in Content Studio, so your menu is showing Content Studio.
Select Switch to Developer Platform beneath the Blotato name, and open the navigation menu first if the sidebar is hidden.
Switching mode changes the navigation, not your subscription, connected accounts, or content.
